item.title: In the Loop: Nature news, what’s in a claim and here we go again
item.description: Welcome to Responsible Investor’s weekly subscriber-only newsletter! We’d love to hear your feedback, email us at edit@responsible-investor.com.

item.title: People & Appointments: Fidelity hires Lazard AM stewardship head
item.description: The latest ESG movers and shakers: Nature Action 100 refreshes advisory board, Lauren Juliff moves to Clean Growth Fund from Storebrand.

item.title: Market participants welcome ‘climate first’ approach to UK sustainability standards
item.description: Some concerns raised over interoperability and Scope 3 opt-outs in FCA's proposed rules.

item.title: Stakeholders praise landmark IPBES business and nature report
item.description: Governments, business and financial institutions urged to collaborate to create an enabling environment for addressing biodiversity loss.

item.title: ‘A conversation that needs to be had’: IA stewardship report lands with a splash
item.description: Investors welcome timely discussion and calls for stewardship to be better integrated into manager and owner relationship.

item.title: ESG round-up: Malaysia to develop sustainable finance taxonomy
item.description: The latest developments in sustainable finance: Sustainable debt in CEE grew 40% YoY in 2025, Korea publishes ESG guidelines for public institutions.

item.title: First study on ISSB reporting reveals double materiality interest
item.description: More than 60% of reporting companies also disclosed estimates on the financial impact of climate risks.

item.title: ESG ‘still an investor concern’ despite strong support for Czech arms IPO
item.description: Arms giant CSG reports keen interest in ESG from investors as bankers say defence still a dealbreaker for some asset owners.

item.title: Are investors rethinking Scope 3 emissions?
item.description: Concerns over emissions calculation and double-accounting are prompting questions about carbon-accounting frameworks.

item.title: ESG round-up: ICMA opposes tougher transition exclusions in revised SFDR
item.description: The latest developments in sustainable finance: New LGPS Central member calls for more use of ESG managers; EU sustainability regs mentions dropped in US corporate statements.
